findings.text: the landed record's evidence anchor href /reckon/plans/the-page-paints-from-an-index-landed resolves to nothing (no such file under docs/plans and the served route returns no resource), so the citation 404s; the record is served at /reckon/evidence/archive/the-page-paints-from-an-index-landed.html, the form the sibling links use.

armed_roots is added as advertised surface with no caller at head — nothing under reckon/, tests/ or the SPA reads it — while docs/plans/the-page-paints-from-an-index.html:84 and the evidence record both describe it as reporting which roots are covered, so either wire it or drop it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 02e2757d; caa09a7c changes reckon/serve.py (+50/-13) and adds the test file, fb655659 is docs-only (189 insertions across three files), and no path lies outside the declared write paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure is mounts.json answering 200 within 2 s of launch while watch construction is held slow; tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:167 asserts exactly that, and the recorded control run (2 failed, 1 passed in 57 s) shows it reddens when the watch is armed before serving.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the served entry point binds and answers before the fleet change watch is armed; reckon/serve.py:3112 constructs the ThreadingHTTPServer ahead of the start_fleet_change_watch call at reckon/serve.py:3114, and the watch now arms one tree at a time on its reader thread (reckon/serve.py:236-251).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete with commits caa09a7c and fb655659, the focused gate result 3 passed in 21.12 s, the executed control, and two pre-existing failures attributed to a concurrent node.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's five declared paths; the diff touches reckon/serve.py, tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py, docs/plans/the-page-paints-from-an-index.html, docs/evidence/archive/the-page-paints-from-an-index-landed.html and docs/figures/the-page-paints-from-an-index/startup-bind-and-arm.svg, every one inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: reinstating the regression reddens tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:167 (proved by the executed control), the arm-completion assertion at tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:192 compares the armed set against the test's own mounts and fails if arming stalls or covers the wrong trees, and the close-during-arming block at reckon/serve.py:247-251 has no direct test.
justifications.evidence: green.log's header names the revision, the command and 3 passed, and caa09a7c..fb655659 leaves reckon/serve.py and tests/ byte-identical (diff --stat empty), so the receipt covers the reviewed code; the manifest's 21.12 s is not the logged figure (20.86 s) and no preserved log names caa09a7c.
justifications.fit: the lock at reckon/serve.py:211, the contextlib.suppress at reckon/serve.py:273 and the LOGGER.warning at reckon/serve.py:245 match idiom already used at reckon/serve.py:315 and reckon/serve.py:858, and the added lines carry no plan label, version or tracker reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/serve.py:3112 binds and listens before the arm at reckon/serve.py:3114, and tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:167 shows the port answering inside 2 s while a tree is still unarmed, the residual being the pre-existing pre-serve work (socket.getfqdn and the print block) that still precedes serve_forever.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the declared write paths, with reckon/serve.py:217 armed_roots the one addition nothing in the tree reads (FINDING).
